brief:
The Israeli military claims to have found a 15-meter-deep underground tunnel near the home of one of the operatives behind Friday's operation in Hebron, according to Maan Wire. An electronic device was reportedly seized from inside the tunnel and transferred for investigation by the Shin Bet security service.

No further details were provided about the nature of the device or the investigation's direction.

title: Israeli military claims discovery of 15-meter tunnel near Hebron attacker's home
